implementation_findings.finding: Read completions do not bind an epoch/snapshot identity. An old loadMore response can merge its captured pre-refresh snapshot after a newer refresh; old refresh errors can overwrite newer state. dispose suppresses notification only.
implementation_findings.minimum_repair: Fence reads using epoch and current snapshot identity; invalidate reads on refresh/dispose; do not allow stale finally to clear a newer busy owner. Preserve existing write request IDs and do not equate UI cancellation with server-write cancellation.
implementation_findings.tests: app/test/features/shared/sh04/sh04_screen_test.dart: Completer-controlled refresh completion order, loadMore then refresh, late failure, dispose

non_copy_decisions: JS local-v* branches do not add branching to sequential SavedWork CAS.
Demo explicit-save preferences do not silently replace existing Sys05 controller update/persistence semantics.
Demo GLOBAL_ALL, allowed=true, fixture scopes and injected health never become Permission or session truth.
Restricted ATX parser does not replace native editor capability; CSS physical constants do not override production motion preferences.
Local memory byte sink, 16MiB and metadata hashes are not remote upload/storage receipts.
Source-bound download hash is not independent authenticity or disk persistence.
topic_scoring.py current formula is retained; demo does not promote the older topic_score.py.
propagation-review belongs to BMP-04 source-statistic relationships, not BMP-07 budget dependency execution.
PNG visual is a generated historical texture/illustration, not mandatory product style or implementation.
CTH-05 remains a read-only date-density projection; schedule writing is not adopted there. ACC-04 remains read-only guard recovery, not an archive/undo executor.
